第65章 不速之客-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》

十月三号，大家正在上第一节政治课。孙军代表站在讲台上，讲的是《论人民民主专政》，声音不高不低，像念经一样。大家都挺直腰板，做着笔记。但王建新用神识扫了一下，没有几个专心致志的在听讲。王建新坐在第三排，腰板挺直，眼睛看着黑板，脑子里却在过昨天抄写的医书内容。也不知道讲了多长时间，终于下课了。

刚下课，一件意想不到的事发生了。

北医来了一位不速之客——协和医院外科主任、钱教授。此人是国内顶级外科专家，早年留学美国约翰霍普金斯大学，带回了当时最先进的外科理念，在断指再植、显微外科领域有极高造诣。他在北京医学界赫赫有名，是公认的“刀霸”级人物。什么叫刀霸？就是拿起手术刀，谁都不服，谁都不如他。

钱教授此行的目的，据说是受某位高层领导之托，来考察工农兵学员的教学质量。钱教授非常愿意接受这个任务。更直接的原因是，他在北京医学界听说了王建新的名字——一等功臣，工农兵学员，针麻胃大部切除。这些标签叠加在一起，让他感到难以置信。

一个工农兵学员，一个没上过正规医学院的人，而且只有初中文化，没有系统的老师教学。凭什么能做这样的手术？

所以他来了。

消息先是传到学生工作办公室，陈主任接到电话的时候，手里的茶缸子差点没拿稳。他放下电话，在办公室里转了三圈，然后亲自跑到教室来找王建新。

“王建新，协和医院的钱教授点名要看你做手术。”陈主任的表情很复杂，有紧张，有期待，也有一丝担忧，“这是一个机会，也是一个挑战。”

“什么手术？”王建新问。

“目前还没定。但他说了，要是你不能做一台让他满意的手术，他就在北京医学界发声，质疑工农兵学员的培养质量。”

这话说得很重，也很狂妄。居然有人敢质疑工农兵学员。陈主任说完，看着王建新，等他反应。

王建新沉默了好一会儿，只说了两个字：“可以。”

当天下午，王建新正在教室上理论课。张老师讲的是病理学，声音不大，但讲得很细。王建新在笔记本上记着笔记，一笔一划，工工整整。在课堂上也提出了好多问题。他的理论虽然已经精通，但实践的经验实在太少了。有好多问题全是凭外挂完成。

突然，教导员推门进来，脸色有些不太好看。他跟张老师点了点头，张老师停下了讲课。教导员走到王建新面前，声音不大，但每个字都听得很清楚：“王建新，马上到急诊室。”

On October 3rd, everyone is taking the first political class.Representative Sun Jun stood on the podium and spoke on "On the People's Democratic Dictatorship". His voice was neither high nor low, like chanting a sutra.Everyone straightened their backs and took notes.But Wang Jianxin scanned it with his spiritual consciousness and found that not many people were listening attentively.Wang Jianxin was sitting in the third row, with his back straight and his eyes looking at the blackboard, while his mind was going through the contents of the medical book he copied yesterday.I don’t know how long I talked for, but get out of class was finally over.

Just after class, an unexpected thing happened.

An uninvited guest came to Peking University—Professor Qian, director of surgery at Union Medical College Hospital.This person is a top surgical expert in the country. He studied at Johns Hopkins University in the United States in his early years and brought back the most advanced surgical concepts at the time. He has extremely high attainments in the fields of replantation of severed fingers and microsurgery.He is well-known in the medical community in Beijing and is recognized as a "sword tyrant".What is a sword tyrant?Even if he picks up the scalpel, no one will accept it, and no one will be as good as him.

The purpose of Professor Qian's trip was reportedly entrusted by a senior leader to inspect the teaching quality of worker, peasant, and soldier students.Professor Qian is very willing to accept this task.The more direct reason is that he heard the name of Wang Jianxin in the Beijing medical community - a first-class meritorious worker, worker, peasant, and soldier student, who underwent subtotal gastrectomy with acupuncture.The combination of these labels made him feel incredible.

A worker, peasant, and soldier student, a person who has never attended a formal medical school, and only has a junior high school education and no systematic teacher teaching.Why can such an operation be done?

So here he is.

The news first reached the student affairs office. When Director Chen received the call, he almost lost his grip on the teapot in his hand.He put down the phone, walked around the office three times, and then ran to the classroom to find Wang Jianxin in person.

"Wang Jianxin, Professor Qian from Union Hospital has called upon you to perform surgery." Director Chen's expression was complicated, with tension, expectation, and a hint of worry. "This is an opportunity and a challenge."

"What kind of surgery?" Wang Jianxin asked.

"It hasn't been decided yet. But he said that if you can't perform an operation that satisfies him, he will speak out in the Beijing medical community and question the quality of the training of worker, peasant and soldier trainees."

These words are very serious and very arrogant.How dare some people question worker, peasant, and soldier students?After Director Chen finished speaking, he looked at Wang Jianxin, waiting for his reaction.

Wang Jianxin was silent for a long time and only said two words: "Okay."

That afternoon, Wang Jianxin was giving a theoretical class in the classroom.Teacher Zhang talks about pathology. His voice is not loud, but he talks very carefully.Wang Jianxin took notes in his notebook, stroke by stroke, and worked neatly.Many questions were also raised in class.Although he is proficient in theory, he has too little practical experience.There are many problems that are all solved by plug-ins.

Suddenly, the instructor opened the door and came in, his face a little unsightly.He nodded to Teacher Zhang, who stopped teaching.The instructor walked up to Wang Jianxin and said in a low voice, but every word was heard clearly: "Wang Jianxin, go to the emergency room immediately."
